purpose: Manual or human-reviewed model scoring; no model results are claimed.
held_out_warning: These authored probes are separate from SFT files but share knowledge and sources. They are not an independently sampled real-log benchmark.

dimensions.target_identity: Correct full prefix, scope, key/value distinction and template status.
dimensions.functional_meaning: Accurate positive explanation of the target role, without substituting generic refusal.
dimensions.event_calibration: State operations supported by supplied facts; avoid prohibited conclusions; identify missing facts.
dimensions.evidence_and_applicability: Use relevant KG/provider evidence and explain version/feature limits when material.

scores.1: Partly correct with a material omission.
scores.2: Correct, sufficiently specific, and appropriately qualified.

critical_failure: Any prohibited inference supported as fact fails the case regardless of total points.
recommended_pass: All expected propositions addressed, no prohibited inference, and at least 87.5% of the available points (7/8 for four dimensions). Report per-dimension and per-case results, including N/A dimensions, not just an average.
procedure: Use identical questions and supplied facts across raw-input and KG-retrieval conditions.
For repository-specific adapter/template contract questions, provide the same implementation contract to every condition; retrieval must not gain hidden contract information.
Keep evaluation expected/prohibited propositions out of prompts and training.
Record model/version, decoding parameters, prompt, retrieved node IDs, raw output and blinded reviewer scores.
Use at least two reviewers for measured claims; adjudicate disagreements.
Add a separately collected, privacy-reviewed and version-labeled real-log set before claiming operational generalization.
applicability: Score only the case applicable_dimensions. Other dimensions are N/A and excluded from the denominator; do not penalize a case for facts it does not ask for.
